card.name: The word judgment in 'in the judgment of'
card.fires_on: The noun 'judgment' (or 'judgement') in 'only when, in the judgment of the physician', common in pregnancy warnings. Weaker on a few other abstract nouns such as 'feasibility' and 'measures'.

modes.label: Judgment of the physician
modes.description: The word judgment inside the phrase 'in the judgment of the physician/IRB' before a benefit-outweighs-risk clause.
modes.example: should not be given to a pregnant woman unless in the<< judgment>> of the physician, the potential benefits outweigh

modes.label: Other abstract nouns
modes.description: Nouns like feasibility or measures after 'the' or 'appropriate' in formal text.
